tasks.short: Install booths and drapes from the plan

steps.what: Open the floor plan and specifications
Install booths and drapes from specifications
Note exhibits the plan could not take

tasks.design: The floor plan and the specifications are opened from {DOCS}. Installing booths, exhibits, displays, carpets, or drapes stays physical, guided by that plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Floor plans were a rolled sheet that did not match the hall.
tasks.enabler_now: The plan can be opened against the specification ids.
tasks.still_hard: Installation is physical, and the building may not match the plan.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer sees a door the plan omitted.
tasks.altitude: The plan is open. Installation stays in the hands.

reach.learn: What the plan could not take

evidence.claim: Opening a floor plan is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an install is booked and ends when the booths and drapes are installed.
A plan has a building id and specification ids, produced by the designer. A specification that is missing is not invented.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether floor plans name booths, carpets, and drapes.
research_questions: Who accepts an install that departs from the plan?

already_counted.description: The hands-on time is already in the main step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when the plan is paper. Installation stays physical. The range is below that case.

tasks.short: Select themes, lighting, colors, and props

steps.what: Record the colors that were refused

tasks.design: An allowed list of themes and props is opened from {DOCS}. Selecting themes, lighting, colors, or props stays with the displayer. The list does not select.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selections were made from memory of what the store owned.
tasks.enabler_now: The owned props and allowed themes can be listed.
tasks.still_hard: The selection is a judgement in the space.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows which color fails under this light.
tasks.altitude: The list shows what exists. The selection stays with the displayer.

evidence.claim: A list of owned props is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a display's look is to be chosen and ends when the displayer records the selection.
A prop has an item id and a color, produced by the inventory. A theme not on the allowed list is not offered as chosen.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.

unknowns: Whether allowed themes are written down.
research_questions: Who may override the displayer's selection?

tasks.short: Consult sales staff on what to feature

steps.what: Open the advertising dates and the range
Consult sales staff on featured merchandise
Determine the time and place of each display

tasks.design: Advertising dates and the range are opened from {CALENDAR} and {ERP}. Consulting advertising or sales staff, and determining the merchandise, time, and place of each display, stay a conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feature decisions were a chain of messages that named different dates.
tasks.enabler_now: The date and the range can be opened before the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: What to feature, and when, is still agreed by people.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows a place that cannot hold that merchandise.
tasks.altitude: The date is visible. The decision stays in the conversation.

tasks.short: Attend planning meetings for product launches

steps.what: List training sessions and planning meetings
Attend corporate planning meetings for launches
Note ideas that apply to this floor

tasks.design: Training sessions and corporate planning meetings are listed from {CALENDAR}. Attending them to obtain ideas for product launches stays in person. A listed title is not an idea.
tasks.previous_blocker: Meetings were missed because the invite was a separate mail.
tasks.enabler_now: The session can be listed with its date.
tasks.still_hard: Being in the room is how the idea is obtained.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer knows which launch idea will not fit this floor.
tasks.altitude: The date is on the list. Attendance stays in person.

role.altitude: Installation follows the floor plan and stays physical. Themes are selected by the displayer. Feature slots are agreed in conversation. Meetings are attended, and a title is not an idea.
reach: The event lead sees what the plan could not take.
Sales sees the slot that was agreed.
skills_to_grow: Do not invent a specification the plan does not have.
